svg.title: shortfree — every free 1–4 character domain
svg.desc: Verified daily across .com, .net, .de, .ai, .io, .dev, .app and .tools. DNS plus RDAP; rescanned daily; open source. Illustrative domain data: x7.dev free; qz.app free; kfo.ai dropping. These are layout examples, not live availability claims.
